shipped.title: Foundations
shipped.summary: The workspace, CI and the self-describing app contract: an app's manifest, its validator and JSON Schema, and the platform CLI that compiles manifests and checks that the core never imports an app.

shipped.title: Local dev environment
shipped.summary: One command starts the whole OS locally: Postgres, Redis, identity, core-api, a dev login stub with seeded users, and a dev gateway in front of every app.

shipped.title: Identity
shipped.summary: The OpenID Connect provider for id.asafarim.site, with sign-in delegated to Hub, plus its published container image and production deploy files.

shipped.title: Control plane
shipped.summary: core-api's registry, permission catalog and lifecycle; the app SDK and Notes, the first built-in app; the Admin console for apps, roles, grants and the audit log.

shipped.title: Event bus and bus auth
shipped.summary: NATS JetStream with CloudEvents, an outbox and relay, durable consumers with dedupe and dead letters, and per-app bus permissions checked by core-api when an app connects.

shipped.title: Event catalog
shipped.summary: Apps upload signed schemas for the events they publish, and the Admin console lists every event type with its publisher, subscribers and schema.

shipped.title: Remove an app
shipped.summary: The last lifecycle step: an admin removes an app, its grants and bus resources are cleaned up, and it can be installed again from scratch.

shipped.title: Health and status board
shipped.summary: core-api checks every active app's live and ready endpoints from its manifest, and the Admin console shows them on one Status page.

shipped.title: This page is live
shipped.summary: asafarim.site now serves the OS landing page from its own container, deployed on its own with one command and no identity. The placeholder page is gone.

shipped.title: Traces, request metrics and trace-id logs
shipped.summary: Every app's requests become OpenTelemetry traces and per-route rate, error and duration metrics, with only route patterns leaving the app, and its JSON log lines carry the trace id. One command starts a local collector.

shipped.title: Install an app from its image
shipped.summary: An app built in another repository is installed from its container image: its manifest travels as an image label and is validated, and one command runs it locally or writes its production compose file.

shipped.title: A private documentation reader
shipped.summary: docs.asafarim.site, the second built-in app: it renders documents from their source repository with contents and search, keeps study notes on a part of a document, and is open only to the people the OS grants it to.

shipped.title: Traces across apps
shipped.summary: One request stays one trace through the gateway, core-api and the event bus, and every app flushes its traces and metrics when it stops.

shipped.title: Backup and purge
shipped.summary: Removing an app first backs up its database. The database is dropped only after a retention window, and only if the backup is still there and unchanged. The CLI can remove, purge and list them.

shipped.title: Manifest review
shipped.summary: Every pull request gets an advisory check that compares an app's manifest with its code: unguarded routes, permissions never checked, and events without a schema or a handler, posted as one comment.

shipped.title: Email codes and passkeys
shipped.summary: id.asafarim.site signs people in with a one-time email code or a passkey, built in the OS with no outside provider, and an admin approves new connections.

shipped.title: Event search
shipped.summary: The Admin console's event catalog answers questions like "which app emits something when an order ships?" by searching event types, apps and schema descriptions.

shipped.title: Database time in every trace
shipped.summary: Queries from core-api, Notes and Docs show up in their request's trace with the operation and the database name only, never the SQL text or its values.

shipped.title: App switcher and account menu
shipped.summary: Every OS app has the same top bar: a switcher to each app you can open, and an account menu with your name and Sign out.

shipped.title: core-api and its own database
shipped.summary: core-api runs in production next to the OS's own Postgres on a private network, started by the deploy only once its encrypted settings are committed. A failed image pull is retried before the deploy gives up.

shipped.title: Down and recovered alerts
shipped.summary: core-api sends one message when an app goes down and one when it recovers, keeps the history on the Status page, and remembers what it already reported across a restart.

shipped.title: Scaffold a new app
shipped.summary: One command writes a new app with its manifest, sign-in, the OS top bar, a permission-checked example route, health endpoints, telemetry and a test. It passes manifest review with no findings.

roadmap.title: Events, finished
roadmap.summary: A read-only live demo of core-api, Admin and Notes, and the production event bus (TLS, operator mode).

roadmap.title: Observability
roadmap.summary: Metrics, traces and logs in one place with dashboards, alerts on traces and metrics, and a public status board.

roadmap.title: AI assist
roadmap.summary: AI help where text matching can't see: drafting a new app's manifest, a deeper manifest review, semantic event search and a read-only copilot in the Admin console.
